description: This file implements activation offloading for memory optimization in PyTorch, providing functions to insert offload/reload nodes into the computational graph, manage stream-based synchronization, and enable activation offloading with prefetching and stream overlap. It is specific to PyTorch's FX graph and CUDA stream management for memory-efficient training.

classes.name: ReloadNodeInfo
classes.description: Holds information on backward reload pattern nodes, transfer size, and estimated transfer time.

classes.name: ReloadQueueEntry
classes.description: Represents an entry in the reload scheduling queue with pattern info and remaining overlap time.

methods.name: None offload_activation_fw(graph: fx.Graph)
methods.description: Inserts CPU offload nodes after last usage of tensors in the forward graph to offload activations to CPU memory.

methods.name: None reload_activation_bw(graph: fx.Graph)
methods.description: Inserts GPU reload nodes before first use of offloaded tensors in the backward pass.

methods.name: bool choose_offload_sets( fwd_module: fx.GraphModule, num_fwd_outputs: int, static_lifetime_input_nodes: OrderedSet[fx.Node], )
methods.description: Decides which nodes to offload based on marking and feasibility, marking nodes with 'saved_for_offloading'.

methods.name: None offload_chosen_sets( fwd_module: fx.GraphModule, bwd_module: fx.GraphModule, )
methods.description: Inserts offload and reload nodes into forward and backward graphs based on earlier decisions.

methods.name: None add_forward_offload_stream_ops(graph: fx.Graph)
methods.description: Adds stream and event synchronization ops around offload nodes in the forward graph for overlapping communication.

methods.name: None add_backward_reload_stream_ops(graph: fx.Graph)
methods.description: Adds stream and event synchronization ops around reload nodes in the backward graph.

methods.name: None put_offload_nodes_on_separate_stream( fwd_module: fx.GraphModule, bwd_module: fx.GraphModule, )
methods.description: Wraps offload nodes with stream operations for asynchronous execution.

methods.name: None _validate_pattern_nodes( fork_node: fx.Node, wait_stream_node: fx.Node, record_event_node: fx.Node, join_node: fx.Node, wait_event_node: fx.Node, )
methods.description: Validates stream pattern nodes match expected structure.

methods.name: int _calculate_transfer_size(device_put_node: fx.Node)
methods.description: Calculates size in bytes for data transfer at device_put node.

methods.name: float _estimate_transfer_time_in_ms(transfer_size_bytes: int)
methods.description: Estimates transfer duration based on size and bandwidth.

methods.name: dict[fx.Node,ReloadNodeInfo] identify_reload_patterns( graph: fx.Graph, nodes_list: list[fx.Node], node_to_idx: dict[fx.Node, int] )
methods.description: Detects backward reload data transfer patterns in the FX graph.

methods.name: None reorder_for_prefetch( nodes_list: list[fx.Node], reload_patterns: dict[fx.Node, ReloadNodeInfo], )
methods.description: Reorders nodes to prefetch reloads earlier, overlapping with compute.

methods.name: None activation_offload_sink_wait(fwd_module: fx.GraphModule)
methods.description: Sinks wait_event nodes for offload completion to the end of the graph for overlap.

methods.name: None activation_reload_prefetch(bwd_module: fx.GraphModule)
methods.description: Prefetches backward reloads by moving pattern nodes earlier in the graph to overlap with computation.

methods.name: None enable_activation_offloading( fwd_module: fx.GraphModule, bwd_module: fx.GraphModule, num_fwd_outputs: int, static_lifetime_input_nodes: OrderedSet[fx.Node], )
methods.description: Main entry point to enable activation offloading, including marking, stream management, and pattern prefetching.

methods.name: bool can_offload( node: fx.Node, fwd_outputs: OrderedSet[fx.Node], model_outputs: OrderedSet[fx.Node], static_lifetime_input_nodes: OrderedSet[fx.Node], )
